Interface BluetoothLe

All Known Implementing Classes:
NativeBluetoothLe
public interface BluetoothLe
The board's Bluetooth LE radio, as a central: it scans for a device that advertises a service, connects to it, and exchanges messages with one characteristic of that service. It knows no protocol; a protocol built on it, such as RemotePoweredUpHub, frames its own messages.

It exists only on the boards with a BLE adapter: UNO R4 WiFi and UNO Q (ArduinoUno.getBluetoothLe()), Nano ESP32, AI Thinker ESP32-CAM, M5Stack Cardputer and Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W. The UNO R3 and UNO WiFi Rev2 have none, so the compiler rejects those accessor calls. Get it once, at startup, and pass it to the protocols built on it.

The radio holds one connection at a time. Its messages are copied through caller-owned byte arrays, so the calls allocate nothing.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      int connect(String serviceUuid, String characteristicUuid, int timeoutMillis, byte[] advertisement, int capacity)
      Scans for the first device advertising serviceUuid, connects to it, and subscribes to notifications on characteristicUuid. Waits at most timeoutMillis, or indefinitely when it is zero or negative. Copies up to capacity bytes of the device's manufacturer data into advertisement.
      Returns:
      the manufacturer data's length, once connected; -1 when no device connected in time

    • isConnected

      boolean isConnected()
      Whether a device connected by connect(String, String, int, byte[], int) is still connected.

    • write

      void write(byte[] message, int length)
      Writes the first length bytes of message to the connected device's characteristic.

    • read

      int read(byte[] buffer, int capacity)
      Copies the next notification from the connected device into buffer, up to capacity bytes, and returns its length. Returns 0 when no notification is waiting; a notification is never empty.

    • disconnect

      void disconnect()
      Disconnects from the connected device.
